what: A stock BUSY Bar, firmware 1.3.1 (8edd2da4), over USB, 11.11.2026: POST /api/apps/stage with a Content-Length over 100 MiB. Each answer is the bytes the bar sent on the connection, as they came. The second answer, 508, is a fault of the firmware (see Device's reception); the emulator does not send it.
